discussion.body: Inspector now shows type, name, x, y, rotation, scale, lock, hide, layerId (read-only), order (read-only). Rotate handle on the selection. Snap includes frame corners, edge midpoints, and center. Undo/redo covers create, delete, transform, and props. How to verify: zoom in, draw, select, nudge x/y in the inspector, undo — field matches the numbers. Waiting on your check.
